meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给 NotebookLM，生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF（16:9），存到源文件旁边；若已配置 WOWerpoint Server，还会上传换成 9:16 手机版分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说「Wowerpoint <文件>」「把这个报告做成幻灯片」等，或要求把单份文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.text: Wowerpoint 这份报告.md，做成幻灯片
say.note: 后台生成，约 10 分钟出 PDF

say.text: 把这个季报做成 kawaii 幻灯片，讲增长故事
say.note: 你的 prompt 会原样传给生成步骤

say.text: 换个 prompt，用刚才的 notebook 再做一版
say.note: 复用 notebook 与源文件，只重跑生成和下载

howto.what_en: Point Claude at one document and it renders a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF (16:9) next to the source file; if the WOWerpoint Server env vars are set, it also uploads the deck and returns a 9:16 mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or otherwise ask to render a single document as narrative slides.

say_en.text: Wowerpoint this report.md and make a slide deck
say_en.note: Runs in background; PDF in ~10 min

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly report into kawaii slides about growth
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim

say_en.text: Redo the deck with a new prompt, reuse that notebook
say_en.note: Reuses notebook and source; only regenerates
